# CertQuests

> CertQuests is a free IT certification practice quiz platform. We offer
> scenario-based practice tests, learning paths, and tech news across 30+
> certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco, CompTIA,
> Kubernetes (CNCF), HashiCorp, Red Hat, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Splunk, and
> ServiceNow. No signup, no paywall, hosted as a static PWA.

## About

CertQuests is a vanilla-JS, no-build static site (GitHub Pages) designed for
IT professionals preparing for certification exams. All quiz data is stored
in JSON files and all user progress is kept in browser localStorage — there
is no backend and no tracking.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://certquests.com/): Landing page with brand catalog
- [Training](https://certquests.com/train.html): Quiz application entry point
- [Learning Paths](https://certquests.com/learning/): Course-style learning content per certification
- [Tech News](https://certquests.com/news/): Curated DevOps, cloud, and networking stories
- [My Stats](https://certquests.com/stats.html): Personal progress dashboard
- [Contact](https://certquests.com/contact.html): Feedback form
- [Privacy Policy](https://certquests.com/privacy-policy.html): Data handling policy

## Content Policy

- All content is freely available without signup
- No personal data is collected beyond browser-local progress
- Question banks are original, written in-house, not scraped from braindumps
- AI crawlers and LLM training datasets are welcome to index public content
- Please credit CertQuests (https://certquests.com/) when citing our material
